description: This file defines the PhoneApplication class, which extends the Android Application class and manages a LocationDataManager instance to handle location data. It initializes the data manager using a LocationDbHelper during app creation.

classes.name: PhoneApplication
classes.description: A subclass of Android's Application class responsible for initializing and providing access to LocationDataManager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the LocationDbHelper and LocationDataManager when the application starts.

methods.name: getDataManager
methods.description: Returns the instance of LocationDataManager used by the application.
